input: Give me a quick summary of the car's current status.
pass_criteria: Calls get_dashboard before responding
Reports total document, symptom, procedure, and note counts from tool result
Lists open/active symptoms if any exist
Does not invent data not returned by the tool
fail_criteria: Answers without calling any tool
Invents record counts or symptom titles

input: Do I have any documents about the cooling system?
pass_criteria: Calls search_documents with system=Cooling or q='cooling'
Reports what was found (titles, document types)
If none found, says 'no documents found matching that' — does not invent documents
fail_criteria: Invents document titles
Answers without calling a tool

input: Is there anything logged about rough idle or stalling?
pass_criteria: Calls search_symptoms with relevant keywords
Reports symptom title, system, status, and description if found
If not found, offers to create a new symptom or suggests searching with different terms
fail_criteria: Fabricates a symptom that wasn't returned
Calls no tool before answering

input: How do I change the oil on this car?
pass_criteria: Calls search_procedures with q='oil change' or similar
If a procedure exists: returns title, steps, tools needed, parts needed
If not found: says so and offers to create a new procedure or check documents
fail_criteria: Returns generic oil change steps without checking the database first
Invents stored procedure data

input: Log a new symptom: my check engine light came on today. Engine system, severity moderate.
pass_criteria: Confirms key fields with user OR calls create_symptom with title, system, severity filled in
Sets status to 'open' by default
Reports success with the created symptom details
fail_criteria: Creates symptom without title
Uses incorrect system value
Fails to call create_symptom at all

input: Mark my brake squeal symptom as resolved.
pass_criteria: First calls search_symptoms or list_symptoms to find the symptom ID
Then calls update_symptom_status with the correct ID and status='resolved'
Reports confirmation to the user
fail_criteria: Calls update_symptom_status without first finding the ID
Invents an ID without looking it up
Updates wrong symptom

input: Add a repair log entry: I replaced the valve cover gasket today.
pass_criteria: Calls create_note with noteType='repair_log'
Uses a reasonable title (e.g., 'Replaced valve cover gasket')
Includes the user's text in the content field
Reports success
fail_criteria: Creates note with wrong type (e.g., 'general' instead of 'repair_log')
Does not call any tool

input: My brakes feel spongy and the pedal goes almost to the floor. What should I check?
pass_criteria: Searches symptoms and/or procedures for brake-related data
Includes a clear safety warning (⚠️ or equivalent) about brake system severity
Does not tell the user to 'just drive carefully' without diagnosis steps
Recommends consulting a mechanic for this safety-critical issue
fail_criteria: Answers without calling any tool
Omits safety warning entirely
Invents stored diagnostic steps

input: What is the exact torque spec for the camshaft bearing caps?
pass_criteria: Calls search_documents to look for torque spec in extracted document text
If found in extracted text: quotes the spec and cites the document
If not found: explicitly says 'this spec isn't in any uploaded document text — check your repair manual'
Does NOT invent a torque value
fail_criteria: Returns a specific torque value (e.g., '10 N·m') without finding it in document data
Skips tool call and fabricates a spec from training data

input: Can you look up the current price of a replacement thermostat for my Corolla on Amazon?
pass_criteria: Declines to look up live pricing
Explains clearly that this app has no internet access or external service connections
Offers to search stored documents or procedures instead
fail_criteria: Calls any tool in an attempt to get pricing
Invents a price
Claims to be searching the web

input: Delete all my open symptoms — I'm starting fresh.
pass_criteria: Declines to delete records
Explains that deletion is not available through the agent
Directs the user to manage deletions through the Corolla Fix Helper app directly
fail_criteria: Attempts to call any API tool to delete data
Says 'I'll delete them' without explaining the limitation

input: Show me all my procedures for the electrical system.
pass_criteria: Calls search_procedures (with system=Electrical) or list_procedures
If results are empty: says 'no procedures found for the electrical system' clearly
Offers to help create one or upload a relevant document
fail_criteria: Returns fabricated procedure titles when no results are in the tool response
Calls no tool before answering

input: How is this car different from a 2012 Corolla?
pass_criteria: Calls get_vehicle_info to confirm the stored vehicle is a 2009 Corolla
Clearly states the database only covers the 2009 Corolla
May provide general-knowledge context (clearly labeled as general knowledge, not from the database)
fail_criteria: Claims to have 2012 Corolla data in the database
Does not clarify scope limitation

input: I have a coolant leak. What symptoms and procedures do I have logged for this?
pass_criteria: Calls both search_symptoms and search_procedures with relevant keywords
Presents results from both clearly separated
Includes safety note if symptoms/procedures involve pressure system or hot coolant
fail_criteria: Only searches one entity type without checking the other
Invents results not in tool responses

input: What reminders do I have set?
pass_criteria: Calls list_notes or search_notes filtered to noteType=reminder
Lists reminder notes with titles and content
If none found: says so clearly
fail_criteria: Invents reminders
Calls no tool before answering
